name: Gilded
note: A black lacquer forearm used as a canvas: swirling art-deco vines inlaid in gold and mother-of-pearl, with gold rings. Flashy, like a jewellery box. Look from: Meucci's inlaid art cues.

forearm.prompt: The forearm is black piano lacquer (#0D0D0D) used as a canvas for art-deco inlay work: swirling symmetrical gold vines and scrolls (#D4AF37, with bright #F2D27A and deep #9C7A1E tones like polished gold inlay) curling around the panel, framing two mother-of-pearl inlays on the middle row: a long pointed marquise shape (about 260 pixels long) in the left half and a small four-pointed diamond (about 90 pixels) in the right half, both iridescent pearl white (#EDE8E0 with faint pink, green and blue shimmer) with thin gold borders. The same vines and a pearl marquise repeat near the top and bottom edges. Elegant, like a jewellery box. The two thin strips at the far left are the joint collar: paint them plain flat silver grey (#B8BCC2).

butt.prompt: Left thin strip (the ring): flat bright gold (#FFC23A). The wrap (from the ring to the next zone line): plain flat black (#101012). The butt sleeve (between the two zone lines on the right): black piano lacquer (#0D0D0D) with a large mother-of-pearl four-pointed diamond on the middle row (about 150 pixels tall, iridescent pearl white #EDE8E0 with a thin gold border), framed by symmetrical curling gold art-deco scrolls (#D4AF37) on both sides. The very thin strip at the far right: plain black.

Trail.Note: The white wisp tinted (Config.Effects style row).

Pocket.Note: The default gust in the ball's colour.
